decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a publicly promoted extension of the firm's flagship biodynamic range, central to its announced organic direction, and built on existing in-house dairy capacity, so management remains strongly committed and would treat any weakness as temporary.

The mild sliced cheese is close to the core cheesemaking business, has been visibly launched with its own product page, and has had too little time on the market to justify withdrawal, so management will persist with it.

The sliced butter cheese draws on the firm's in-house cheesemaking and its recent public presentation, and can still attribute modest early results to launch-phase effects, so management will keep it.
